annotations.title: Share a signed result as a public-safe page

description: Make a public-safe page for a signed LLPRO result you got from a trust tool: /r/<token> (192-bit link, noindex, expires, revocable) with JSON and PDF files, and an ICS calendar file when the result carries a date. Only answers whose signature checks out and that are in the Trust Log. Gives back a revoke secret (once) and a ready email text (LLPRO sends no mail).

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; must appear in the signed answer

record.description: the signed answer exactly as the tool gave it: {observation, signature}

name: result_share
title: Share a signed result as a public-safe page
